description: Permanently enable the view-level permissions feature by removing its feature flag. This change makes the feature always available when an enterprise license is active, without requiring the flag to be toggled. Ensure proper license validation remains in place to restrict access when the license expires.
functional_requirements: Remove the feature flag logic that currently gates view-level permissions functionality
Update the enterprise plugin to always enable view-level permissions when the enterprise license is active
Ensure license expiration handling continues to work correctly, preventing new restricted views from being created and showing appropriate UI indicators for existing restricted views
